experiment.name: text-independent-authorization-fragility-router
experiment.routing_policy: review an allowed producer claim when every alternative structured claim kind would flip the scope decision
limitations: This is a post-hoc development replay over four hand-authored corpora.
Verifier calls were already executed; selected token counts are counterfactual attribution, not realized savings.
The threshold must remain frozen for a future prospective holdout.
The two recorded model IDs do not establish independent failure modes.
